premises.text: Existing nighttime safety gear (high-vis, retro-reflectives, taillights) has limited functionality, poor off-angle visibility, and unfashionable aesthetics
premises.evidence_span: these are incredibly limited in their functionality and often invisible from outside angles

premises.text: App-connected wearable smart lighting tracks destination to auto-trigger turn signals, intersection strobes, and brake lights for driver communication
premises.evidence_span: it automatically engages a left turn signal when I get to that turn

premises.text: Combined advanced hardware and software can turn harvestable data into lighting cues, including performance pace coaching
premises.evidence_span: combined advanced hardware with luminous software and an endless opportunity for animation and colors

premises.text: Go-to-market spans DTC activewear, college bookstores, brand licensing, and industrial/enterprise safety, including a smart helmet partnership
premises.evidence_span: working with brands that you already know and love through licensing engagements

value.text: Save lives by making riders and pedestrians visible and communicative at night while looking good
value.evidence_span: wearable smart lighting designed to save lives

causal_links.evidence_span: It's time to bring safety into the 21st century
This keeps you safe and seen
keep their students safe at night

notes: Turn/strobe/brake features folded as cascade of one destination-aware lighting mechanism; pace lighting kept inside hardware+software data-to-light premise. Pre-order counts and team credentials excluded. ASR 'government automatically begins to strobe' treated as garment strobe in coding text; evidence uses nearby contiguous turn-signal span.
